scripts.generate: bun run --cwd platform distribute && bun run --cwd apps/files gen && bun run --cwd apps/mail gen
scripts.test: bun run --cwd platform test && bun run --cwd apps/files test && bun run --cwd apps/mail test && bun test scripts
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd platform typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/files typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/mail typecheck && bunx tsc --noEmit
scripts.check: bun run generate && bun run test && bun run typecheck
